lore.common: Bumps into the same window forty times, then flies straight out of the open door beside it.
lore.uncommon: Comes home so covered in pollen that it looks like a tiny flying cheese puff.
lore.rare: Does a wiggly dance that tells the whole hive exactly where your picnic jam is.
lore.epic: Led the whole hive into the bakery to taste the doughnuts. The baker now sells them pre-licked.
lore.legendary: Made enough honey in one summer to fill the village pond. The ducks are very sticky and very happy.

lore.common: Falls on its back and waves its legs in the air until someone helps it, then walks off without thanks.
lore.uncommon: Rolls a ball of dung bigger than itself across the field and won't let anyone help.
lore.rare: Its shell shines so brightly in the sun that magpies keep trying to steal it.
lore.epic: Rolled its dung ball so far that it gathered half the field and turned into a hill.
lore.legendary: Steered by the stars to roll its ball across the entire desert in a perfectly straight line, then started a second one.

lore.common: Rolls into a tight ball the moment anyone lifts the flowerpot, then refuses to come out.
lore.uncommon: Has fourteen legs and still takes ages to cross the patio.
lore.rare: Rolled down the garden path like a tiny armoured marble and knocked over a toy soldier.
lore.epic: Moved in under a log with ten thousand cousins and the log started walking.
lore.legendary: Rolled itself up so tightly that it survived being stepped on by an elephant, then complained about the noise.

lore.common: Flutters into the bedroom at night and sits on the lampshade like a tiny green ghost.
lore.uncommon: Its wings look like delicate lace, so it gets very upset when it flies into a cobweb.
lore.rare: Eats so many aphids that the roses have started sending it thank-you notes.
lore.epic: Cleared every aphid out of the town's rose gardens in one summer. The flower show was the best ever.
lore.legendary: Protected a whole orchard from greenfly for a decade and was given a little lace medal by the apples.

lore.common: Nibbles a perfect little hole in every lettuce leaf, so the salad looks like lace.
lore.uncommon: Its shell glints like a jewel, so it thinks it's far too fancy to hide.
lore.rare: Plays dead and drops off the leaf whenever a gardener comes near, then climbs back up.
lore.epic: Munched through every bean plant on the allotment in one night. The gardener now grows plastic flowers.
lore.legendary: Ate a leaf so cleverly that it left a perfect portrait of the gardener in the holes.

lore.common: Jumps off the leaf whenever you look at it, then lands on your nose.
lore.uncommon: Hops sideways round the stem to hide on the other side, like a tiny game of hide and seek.
lore.rare: Leapt so high off a rose that it landed on the roof of the greenhouse.
lore.epic: Hopped across the whole garden in one go and set off every wind chime on the way.
lore.legendary: Jumped from one end of the park to the other in a single bounce. The squirrels had to sit down.

lore.common: Its antennae are so long that it keeps poking itself in the back.
lore.uncommon: Squeaks like a little door hinge when you pick it up, then looks embarrassed.
lore.rare: Chewed through a wooden fence post so neatly that the fence still stands but makes a whistling sound.
lore.epic: Bored so many tunnels in the old oak that the wind now plays it like a flute.
lore.legendary: Chewed a perfect castle out of a single log and moved in with its whole family.

lore.common: Holds its arms together as if praying, then grabs your sandwich.
lore.uncommon: Turns its head right round to look at you over its shoulder, like a suspicious librarian.
lore.rare: Waits so still on a flower that the flies land on it to rest. Then it isn't still.
lore.epic: Practised kung fu poses on every rose in the garden so dramatically that the snails moved away.
lore.legendary: Waited perfectly still for a whole day for one fly, caught it, and was given a black belt by the spiders.

lore.common: Runs so fast across the beach that it overshoots its own lunch.
lore.uncommon: Its shell glitters green and gold in the sun as it races about.
lore.rare: Runs so fast that its eyes can't keep up, so it stops to look around and starts again.
lore.epic: Raced across the whole beach so quickly that it left a little trail of tiny sandstorms.
lore.legendary: Became the fastest runner of any creature for its size, then retired to sunbathe on a warm rock.

lore.common: Scuttles along the bottom of the rockpool and looks offended that nobody recognises it.
lore.uncommon: Was found in a rock by a schoolgirl and has been showing off its stony shell ever since.
lore.rare: Rolled itself into a ball so old and hard that a geologist's hammer bounced off it.
lore.epic: Woke up in a museum display and scuttled round the whole gallery before anyone noticed.
lore.legendary: Lived for millions of years before the dinosaurs, and still turns up in rocks looking smug.

lore.common: Lands on your nose for exactly one second, then flies away just as you try to take a photo.
lore.uncommon: Its wings are covered in tiny patterns that make the flowers jealous.
lore.rare: Fluttered round a garden party so prettily that every guest forgot what they were saying.
lore.epic: Led a cloud of a million butterflies through the meadow and the flowers thought spring had come twice.
lore.legendary: Flew across an entire continent on wings as thin as paper, then landed on the exact same tree as its grandmother.

lore.common: Is so small and blue that people think a piece of the sky has fallen off.
lore.uncommon: Its caterpillar makes friends with ants, which carry it home and feed it.
lore.rare: Has fake little antennae on its wing tips, so birds peck at the wrong end.
lore.epic: Fluttered over a hillside with a thousand friends and the hill looked like it was turning blue.
lore.legendary: Was carried home by an ant army that thought it was their queen, and was waited on for a whole summer.

lore.common: Bumps into the same lamp again and again all night, then falls asleep on the lampshade.
lore.uncommon: Nibbled a hole in your favourite jumper, then left a perfect wing-shaped dust print as a signature.
lore.rare: Its dusty wings leave a powdery print on everything it touches, including the cat.
lore.epic: Brought every moth in the neighbourhood to the porch light. The light switch now has a queue.
lore.legendary: Flew towards the Moon all night and swears it got very close, then landed back on the porch light.

lore.common: Flutters slowly through the long grass looking tired, even first thing in the morning.
lore.uncommon: Has little ring patterns on its wings that look like eyes, so it can watch you twice.
lore.rare: Flies even in cloudy weather when other butterflies are sulking indoors.
lore.epic: Fluttered through a meadow with so many friends that walkers thought the grass was blinking.
lore.legendary: Kept watch over the same meadow for a whole summer, flapping its eye-wings at every bird that came near.

lore.common: Sips from muddy puddles on the path and gets in the way of every cyclist.
lore.uncommon: Is so bright yellow that people think it's a dropped lemon sweet.
lore.rare: Flutters so fast and erratically that birds give up trying to follow it.
lore.epic: Gathered a flock of yellow butterflies so huge over a puddle that it looked like a pool of sunshine.
lore.legendary: Flew in a golden cloud so bright that the town turned off its street lights for the evening.

lore.common: Eats a hole in every leaf in the garden, then sleeps on what's left.
lore.uncommon: Inches along by arching its whole body, like it's measuring the garden.
lore.rare: Ate its own weight in cabbage in a single day, then asked for dessert.
lore.epic: Munched through an entire vegetable patch in one night. The gardener now grows only flowers.
lore.legendary: Ate so much in one summer that it turned into the most beautiful butterfly in the valley and forgot it was ever hungry.

names.legendary: Centipedia, Owner of All the Shoes

lore.common: Scuttles out from under the bathroom mat just as you step on it.
lore.uncommon: Has so many legs that it never finishes putting its shoes on.
lore.rare: Runs so fast round the skirting boards that the cat has given up chasing it.
lore.epic: Sprinted through the whole house in one night and every slipper was moved to a different room.
lore.legendary: Bought one shoe for each foot, then opened the biggest shoe shop in the garden.

lore.common: Pops up through the lawn every time it rains, then gets lost on the path.
lore.uncommon: Wiggles through the soil all day, eating dirt and making the garden happier.
lore.rare: Churned the flowerbed so well that every plant in it grew twice as tall.
lore.epic: Ploughed the whole allotment in one night. The farmer woke up to perfect rows.
lore.legendary: Turned over every field in the county with nothing but wiggling. The tractors are now museum pieces.

lore.common: Sticks to your ankle when you paddle in the pond and refuses to say goodbye.
lore.uncommon: Stretches and loops along the pond floor like a slow, wobbly rubber band.
lore.rare: Clung onto a fisherman's boot so tightly that it went home with him and moved into the shed.
lore.epic: Ambushed every paddler at the summer lake. The swimmers now wear wellies.
lore.legendary: Became so famous for clinging on that the rock-climbers asked it for lessons.

lore.common: Curls into a spiral when touched and stays that way until you go away.
lore.uncommon: Walks with a ripple of legs that looks like a wave going down its body.
lore.rare: Releases a funny smell when frightened, which makes birds sneeze and fly off.
lore.epic: Led a parade of a thousand millipedes across the forest floor. The leaves moved like a carpet.
lore.legendary: Walked with a thousand legs and never once tripped, and became the forest's dance teacher.

names.legendary: Homarus, Who Walked Out of the Sea

lore.common: Snaps its claws at the restaurant tank glass every time someone points at it.
lore.uncommon: Has one big crushing claw and one small pinching claw, and argues with itself about which is better.
lore.rare: Walked out of the lobster pot, down the pier and back into the sea while the fisherman was looking at his phone.
lore.epic: Led a march of lobsters across the seabed so long that it blocked the fishing lanes for a week.
lore.legendary: Lived for a hundred years at the bottom of the sea, grew a claw as big as a door, and still won't share a single mussel.

lore.common: Scuttles sideways across the beach and pinches your toe when you try to walk the other way.
lore.uncommon: Blows little bubbles from its mouth when it's thinking hard about something.
lore.rare: Pinched the bucket handle so tightly that the child had to take the crab home in the bucket.
lore.epic: Led an army of crabs sideways across the beach. The sandcastles didn't stand a chance.
lore.legendary: Walked sideways across the entire seabed from one coast to the other, then wondered why it hadn't walked forwards.

lore.common: Waves its one giant claw at everyone, like it's trying to get a taxi.
lore.uncommon: Waves its big claw in rhythm with a hundred neighbours, so the beach looks like a crowd at a concert.
lore.rare: Snapped its huge claw so hard that it made a sound like a firework.
lore.epic: Waved its claw so wildly with a thousand friends that seagulls thought the beach was cheering them.
lore.legendary: Became conductor of the biggest beach orchestra ever, with ten thousand crabs waving claws in time.

lore.common: Tries on every shell on the beach and complains that none of them have enough cupboard space.
lore.uncommon: Swaps shells with its neighbours in a long queue, from smallest to biggest, every spring.
lore.rare: Moved into a bottle cap and now lives in the smallest, shiniest house on the beach.
lore.epic: Organised a shell market where a thousand hermit crabs swapped homes in one afternoon.
lore.legendary: Moved into a teapot and turned it into the grandest house on the seabed, with a spout for a chimney.

lore.common: Zigzags across the pond so fast that it never lands where you think it will.
lore.uncommon: Can hover in one spot like a tiny helicopter, then shoot backwards.
lore.rare: Catches mosquitoes mid-air so neatly that the summer evenings are suddenly peaceful.
lore.epic: Performed an air show over the pond with a hundred others and the frogs held up scorecards.
lore.legendary: Has been patrolling ponds since before the dinosaurs, and still has the best eyesight in the garden.

lore.common: Wiggles round and round the pond, bumping into everyone, and never says sorry.
lore.uncommon: Woke up one morning with two new back legs and has been showing them off ever since.
lore.rare: Grew its front legs, lost its tail and turned into a frog in a single afternoon.
lore.epic: Hatched with ten thousand siblings and the pond looked like a bowl of wiggling rice.
lore.legendary: Grew up to be the loudest frog in the pond and still tells the young tadpoles about its tail days.

names.legendary: Sir Croakalot, the Prince in Waiting

lore.common: Jumps into the pond with a huge splash right next to anyone who's just sat down.
lore.uncommon: Croaks so loudly on summer nights that the neighbours have bought earplugs.
lore.rare: Flicks its tongue out so fast that it catches flies before they've even noticed it.
lore.epic: Led a croaking chorus so loud that the whole village thought it was a brass band.
lore.legendary: Was kissed by a hundred hopeful princesses and stayed a frog every time. Says it's quite happy, thank you.

names.legendary: Ascaphus, Frog of the Rushing Water

lore.common: Clings to stones in fast streams with its belly so it doesn't get washed away.
lore.uncommon: Has no voice and can't croak, so it waves at the other frogs instead.
lore.rare: Lives in water so cold and fast that the trout ask it how it copes.
lore.epic: Hopped up a whole mountain waterfall stone by stone. The hikers stopped to cheer.
lore.legendary: Has lived in the same rushing stream for so long that the stream now flows politely around it.

lore.common: Sits in the middle of the garden path and refuses to move for anyone.
lore.uncommon: Puffs itself up to look bigger whenever a dog sniffs it.
lore.rare: Ate every slug in the vegetable patch in one night, then had a lie-in.
lore.epic: Led a march of a thousand toads across the country road. The traffic stopped for an hour.
lore.legendary: Kept the whole village's gardens slug-free for a decade, and was given a tiny bench of its own.

names.legendary: Lady Coccinella of the Seven Spots

lore.common: Lands on your hand and walks to the end of your finger, then can't decide whether to fly.
lore.uncommon: Has exactly seven spots and gets upset when anyone counts only six.
lore.rare: Ate so many greenflies that the roses started blooming in December.
lore.epic: Swarmed over a farmer's field with a million friends and saved every crop from greenfly.
lore.legendary: Rescued every rose garden in the land from greenfly in one summer, and was given its very own flower show.

lore.common: Points one eye at you and the other at the ceiling, so you never know which one is listening.
lore.uncommon: Walks so slowly, rocking back and forth like a leaf, that snails overtake it.
lore.rare: Turns dark and stripy when it is cross, and it is cross about nearly everything.
lore.epic: Flashed so many angry colours at a rival that the whole tree looked like a disco.
lore.legendary: Changed colour to match a rainbow so perfectly that a family photographed the sky and missed it entirely.

lore.common: Lies so still on the riverbank that hikers sit on it for a picnic, then move very quickly.
lore.uncommon: Floats with only its eyes and nose above the water, like a log with opinions.
lore.rare: Lets little birds pick its teeth clean, then grins at everyone to show off.
lore.epic: Waited so long at the river crossing that the whole herd of zebras decided to go round the long way.
lore.legendary: Has been lying on the same sandbank for eighty years and has outlasted three bridges.

lore.common: Does push-ups on a hot rock whenever anyone walks past, whether they're watching or not.
lore.uncommon: Its head turns bright orange in the sun while the rest of it stays blue.
lore.rare: Nods its head so fiercely at its rivals that they get dizzy and wander off.
lore.epic: Led a hundred lizards in a head-bobbing contest on the village wall. The village thought it was an earthquake.
lore.legendary: Did one hundred push-ups on the hottest rock in the desert without stopping, then had a cheeky drink of dew.

lore.common: Wriggles away from your hand, then leaves its tail behind wiggling on the path.
lore.uncommon: Has a little fold down each side so it can puff up after a big lunch.
lore.rare: Hid in a gardener's glove all morning and gave him the shock of his life.
lore.epic: Lost its tail, grew a new one, and lost that one too, all in one busy summer.
lore.legendary: Ate every slug in the vegetable patch, then slept for a week in a flowerpot with its belly full.

lore.common: Lies in the golf course pond and refuses to give back the ball.
lore.uncommon: Bellows so loudly in spring that the swamp water dances on its back.
lore.rare: Digs a hole in the mud that turns into a pond, then lets the turtles stay for free.
lore.epic: Gave one bellow that shook every frog off every lily pad in the swamp.
lore.legendary: Ruled the same swamp for sixty years and still remembers where every dropped picnic sandwich landed.

names.legendary: Anolis, Knight of the Porch Rail

lore.common: Pops out its pink throat flap at you, then pretends it didn't.
lore.uncommon: Turns brown when nervous and green when it calms down, like a mood ring with legs.
lore.rare: Runs along the porch rail so fast that it overshoots and lands in the flower pot.
lore.epic: Flapped its throat at every lizard on the street until they all moved two gardens away.
lore.legendary: Defended the same porch rail against every rival for its whole life, and the family named the porch after it.

lore.common: Chirps in the dark when you try to sleep, then hides as soon as you turn on the light.
lore.uncommon: Waves its tail like a cat before it pounces on a beetle.
lore.rare: Walks on tiptoe across the hot sand at night, so quietly that the scorpions don't hear it.
lore.epic: Hunted every cricket in the campsite in one night. The campers slept peacefully for the first time.
lore.legendary: Crossed the whole desert by moonlight on tiptoe, and arrived in time to watch the sunrise from a cactus.

lore.common: Wanders out of the pond and gets lost under the garden shed every autumn.
lore.uncommon: Grows a wavy crest along its back each spring and won't stop showing it off.
lore.rare: Flashed its bright orange belly at a heron, which decided to eat something else.
lore.epic: Led a parade of newts across the lane to the pond, and the postman had to wait for an hour.
lore.legendary: Grew back a whole new leg after losing one to a fish, then went straight back to bossing the pond.

lore.common: Comes out to wander only on rainy days, then complains when it gets wet.
lore.uncommon: Is bright orange so everyone knows it tastes horrible, and it's quite proud of that.
lore.rare: Walked across the whole forest floor in one rainy afternoon, past every hungry bird.
lore.epic: Led a thousand orange efts across the woodland path after a storm. Walkers had to tiptoe for an hour.
lore.legendary: Wandered through the woods for three whole years before finally deciding which pond to live in.

lore.common: Hides under logs all day and only comes out when it rains, then sits on the path.
lore.uncommon: Wears black with bright yellow blotches, the forest's way of saying do not lick.
lore.rare: Was mistaken for a firework by campers who threw it on the fire. It walked out very cross.
lore.epic: Came out with a hundred others after a storm and the forest looked like it was covered in sunflowers.
lore.legendary: Walked out of a campfire unharmed, and the old legend about salamanders and fire was born.

lore.common: Opens its huge neck frill whenever someone steps near, like an umbrella opening in your face.
lore.uncommon: Runs away on its back legs only, looking like a tiny dinosaur late for the bus.
lore.rare: Hissed and flared its frill so suddenly that a dingo ran home to its mum.
lore.epic: Opened its frill at a road train and the driver stopped to let it cross.
lore.legendary: Scared off an eagle, a snake and a dingo in one afternoon, then folded its frill and went for a nap.

lore.common: Bites onto things and won't let go, including the doormat.
lore.uncommon: Stores fat in its tail, so it only needs to eat three big meals a year.
lore.rare: Its bumpy scales look like tiny beads, and the crows keep trying to collect them.
lore.epic: Spent the whole summer in its burrow and the desert was suspiciously quiet.
lore.legendary: Ate one giant meal of eggs and didn't need dinner again for a whole year.

lore.common: Sunbathes on the garden wall and sprints away the moment you open the back door.
lore.uncommon: Is so bright green that people think it's a toy dropped by a child.
lore.rare: Climbed the side of the house to sunbathe on the window ledge, and stared into the bathroom.
lore.epic: Raced along every garden wall in the village in one morning, and the cats were too slow to keep up.
lore.legendary: Turned bright blue on its throat in spring, and every lizard in the valley came to see it.

lore.common: Sits on the hottest rock in the garden all afternoon and refuses to share it.
lore.uncommon: Its tail twitches when it's excited, which is when it sees a fly.
lore.rare: Climbed straight up the side of the house and peered through the window at your breakfast.
lore.epic: Led every lizard in the garden to sunbathe on the patio, and nobody could put out their chairs.
lore.legendary: Has sunbathed on the same rock for so long that the rock now has a lizard-shaped warm spot.

lore.common: Hides under logs all year and pops out only on the rainiest night, as if it's a special occasion.
lore.uncommon: Its yellow polka dots look like someone flicked paint on it.
lore.rare: Marched across the road on the first rainy night of spring and stopped all the traffic.
lore.epic: Led a thousand salamanders to the spring pool in one night. The road was closed until morning.
lore.legendary: Has walked to the same pool on the same rainy night for twenty years, without ever checking a map.

lore.common: Dashes across the hot sand, stops, flicks its tongue, then dashes off in a new direction.
lore.uncommon: Has pale stripes down its back like a racing car.
lore.rare: Ran so fast across the trail that hikers thought they had seen a ghost.
lore.epic: Raced across a whole desert canyon in one go, leaving a trail of tiny dust clouds.
lore.legendary: Its whole family are sisters, and together they won every race in the desert without a single brother.

lore.common: Rides out every wave glued flat to its rock, then creeps off to graze the moment the tide goes out.
lore.uncommon: Has eight little plates on its back, like a tiny armadillo of the sea.
lore.rare: Licks the algae off rocks with a tongue full of tiny iron teeth.
lore.epic: Scraped every rock in the rockpool clean in one night. The seaweed was furious.
lore.legendary: Held on to the same rock through a hundred storms, and the rock is now named after it.

lore.common: Glides across the bottom of the pond like a tiny flat ribbon that has lost its present.
lore.uncommon: Can be cut in half and grow back as two flatworms, which is why it's never lonely.
lore.rare: Ripples through the water with its colourful edges, like a little flag waving.
lore.epic: Split itself into a hundred flatworms, and the pond had a very sudden population boom.
lore.legendary: Grew a whole new head after losing it, and still remembered where it left its lunch.

lore.common: Is so small that it lives in a single spoonful of soil with a million friends.
lore.uncommon: Wiggles through the soil in an S-shape, like it's drawing on a tiny map.
lore.rare: Gets into the roots of tomato plants and ties them in little knots.
lore.epic: A billion of them moved into one garden and the potatoes all grew knobbly.
lore.legendary: Is found everywhere on Earth, from the top of mountains to the bottom of the sea, and still nobody notices it.

lore.common: Lies on the seabed like a sausage someone dropped, and doesn't move all day.
lore.uncommon: Sifts the sand all day and leaves neat little sandy squiggles behind it.
lore.rare: Squirts sticky threads at crabs that bother it, then glides away.
lore.epic: Hoovered so much sand that the whole bay was cleaner than a swimming pool.
lore.legendary: Cleaned the whole seabed of a lagoon with nothing but a slow crawl, and the fish now swim there to admire it.

lore.common: Crawls over the coral looking so fancy that the clownfish are jealous.
lore.uncommon: Wears a fringe of frilly feathers on its back, as if it is going to a party every day.
lore.rare: Eats stinging jellyfish and keeps their stings for itself, without a thank-you.
lore.epic: Crawled across a whole reef with a hundred neon cousins and the divers forgot to breathe.
lore.legendary: Is the brightest creature on the reef, and the colour-changing octopus asks it for fashion tips.

lore.common: Leaves a shiny slime trail across the kitchen floor every night.
lore.uncommon: Eats a hole in every lettuce in the garden, then hides under the watering can.
lore.rare: Squeezed through the keyhole and slimed its way to the cat's dinner bowl.
lore.epic: Led a hundred slugs on a midnight raid of the vegetable patch. The gardener cried into his cocoa.
lore.legendary: Ate a whole lettuce bigger than itself in one night, then had a nap inside the hole it made.

lore.common: Crawls up the window and sticks there, staring at you all evening.
lore.uncommon: Pulls itself back into its shell whenever anyone says hello.
lore.rare: Slid all the way across the patio in one rainy night and left a shiny map behind it.
lore.epic: Climbed to the top of a sunflower with a hundred friends and the flower bent over to say hello.
lore.legendary: Raced a tortoise across the garden and won, because the tortoise stopped for lunch.

lore.common: Rattles its tail at everything, including tumbleweeds and its own shadow.
lore.uncommon: Has a pattern of diamonds down its back that looks like a fancy jumper.
lore.rare: Rattled so loudly from under a rock that a whole cowboy film crew ran away.
lore.epic: Rattled with a hundred cousins at once and the canyon echoed like a giant maraca.
lore.legendary: Grew the longest rattle in the desert, one bead for every shed skin, and uses it as a doorbell.

lore.common: Slithers out from under the compost heap just as you reach for a garden fork.
lore.uncommon: Has neat stripes down its back like it's wearing a little sports kit.
lore.rare: Makes a terrible smell when picked up, so nobody picks it up twice.
lore.epic: Came out of hibernation with ten thousand others and the whole field looked like it was wriggling.
lore.legendary: Is the most common snake in the garden, and has seen every gardener in the street fall over in fright.

lore.common: Lies in the trees so still and green that birds land on it, then leave quickly.
lore.uncommon: Moves through the branches so fast that it looks like the leaves are flowing.
lore.rare: Shot through the treetops so quickly that a monkey dropped its banana in surprise.
lore.epic: Raced from one end of the forest to the other through the treetops without touching the ground.
lore.legendary: Is so fast and so green that nobody has ever taken a clear photo of it, which suits it perfectly.

lore.common: Hides in the green grass and makes everyone jump when they spot it.
lore.uncommon: Is so thin and green that people think it's a vine until it slithers away.
lore.rare: Catches crickets in the meadow so quietly that the other crickets keep singing.
lore.epic: Slithered through every flower bed in the park and the gardeners thought the plants were dancing.
lore.legendary: Hid in the same hedge for twenty years and nobody ever spotted it, even the owl.

lore.common: Flips onto its back and plays dead whenever anyone comes near, tongue out and all.
lore.uncommon: Has a turned-up nose like a little shovel, which it uses to dig up toads.
lore.rare: Hisses and puffs itself up like a cobra, but it's only pretending.
lore.epic: Played dead so well in the middle of the path that a group of hikers held a little funeral for it.
lore.legendary: Faked its own death so convincingly that a crow gave up, a fox gave up and the hawk said a few kind words.

lore.common: Buries itself in the sand with only its eyes and little horns showing, like a sandy rabbit.
lore.uncommon: Slides sideways across the dunes and leaves funny J-shaped tracks.
lore.rare: Hid so well in the sand that a camel stepped right over it and never knew.
lore.epic: Moved through the whole desert sideways and left a trail of ripples so long it looked like writing.
lore.legendary: Has waited under the same sand dune for so long that the dune has moved round it twice.

lore.common: Spreads its hood at anything that comes near, including the garden hose.
lore.uncommon: Has a mark on the back of its hood that looks like a pair of glasses.
lore.rare: Sways so gracefully in front of the flute player that the audience doesn't notice it can't hear.
lore.epic: Spread its hood at a mongoose so dramatically that the mongoose went home to think about its life.
lore.legendary: Stood up so tall in the long grass that it looked over the fence, the hedge and into next door's kitchen.

lore.common: Slithers into the airing cupboard every winter and curls up on the warmest towel.
lore.uncommon: Wears red, black and yellow bands to look dangerous, but it's only copying its scary cousin.
lore.rare: Isn't bothered by rattlesnake venom at all, which makes the rattlesnakes very nervous.
lore.epic: Cleared every rattlesnake out of the ranch in one summer, and the cowboys finally took off their tall boots.
lore.legendary: Swallowed a snake longer than itself, then lay in the sun for a fortnight looking like a garden hose with a secret.

lore.common: Waits until everyone has gone to bed, then slithers across the patio and sets off the security light.
lore.uncommon: Has eyes with narrow slits like a cat, and stares at moths the same way.
lore.rare: Fits into any crack in a stone wall, so it can disappear in the time it takes to turn round.
lore.epic: Patrolled the whole canyon by moonlight and ate every lizard that hadn't gone to bed on time.
lore.legendary: Has never once been seen in daylight, so the canyon's owls insist it's just a rumour.

lore.common: Rattles at the garden hose, the wheelbarrow and anyone who drops a teaspoon.
lore.uncommon: Feels the warmth of a mouse in total darkness with two little pits on its face.
lore.rare: Coiled up under the porch steps and kept the whole family using the back door for a month.
lore.epic: Rattled from every rock in the canyon at once, and the hikers thought a rainstorm was coming.
lore.legendary: Has rattled at so many cowboys, coyotes and cameras that it now owns the most famous rattle in the desert.

lore.common: Hides under every stone you lift in the garden, then looks annoyed that you found it.
lore.uncommon: Curls its tail into a corkscrew to flash its bright orange belly when it's frightened.
lore.rare: Wears a neat yellow ring round its neck, so it always looks ready for a party.
lore.epic: Hid in every flowerpot in the garden centre at once, and the staff found a snake under every plant.
lore.legendary: Lived under the same garden stone for twenty years, and three generations of children have said hello to it.

lore.common: Swallows its dinner whole, then lies in the sun for a week looking like it ate a football.
lore.uncommon: Wraps itself round anything warm, including a sleeping farmer's leg.
lore.rare: Can go a whole year without eating, then complains about being peckish.
lore.epic: Squeezed so hard round a fallen tree that it snapped the trunk in two.
lore.legendary: Grew so long that it was used as a measuring tape by the village, and refused to hold still.

lore.common: Pops up next to snorkellers to breathe, then swims off before they can scream.
lore.uncommon: Has a flat tail like a paddle and can't crawl on land, so it flops about crossly if washed ashore.
lore.rare: Holds its breath for two hours on the seabed and peeks into every crack in the coral.
lore.epic: Swam into the harbour with a thousand cousins and the fishing boats stayed home for a week.
lore.legendary: Swam across a whole ocean on the warm currents, then poked its head up at a beach café to ask directions.

names.legendary: Crotalus Cerastes, Dancer of the Dunes

lore.common: Moves sideways across the sand so it only touches the hot ground with two little bits at a time.
lore.uncommon: Has little horns above its eyes to keep the sand out, like built-in sunglasses.
lore.rare: Buries itself in the sand with only its eyes peeking out, and waits for a lizard to sit on it.
lore.epic: Drew a pattern of curvy tracks across the dunes so large that pilots thought someone had written a message.
lore.legendary: Crossed the whole desert in the noon sun by never letting more than two spots touch the sand at once.

lore.common: Hides in the garden shed and hisses at the lawnmower every Saturday.
lore.uncommon: Flicks its tongue to taste the air, and knows you had cheese for lunch.
lore.rare: Shed its whole skin in one piece and left it on the sofa for someone else to find.
lore.epic: Slithered out of the zoo, round the town and back into its tank before the keepers' tea break ended.
lore.legendary: Escaped from every tank, basket and box it was ever put in, and was finally given the key.

names.legendary: Carphophis, Who Rises with the Rain

lore.common: Looks so much like an earthworm that robins keep trying to pull it out of the lawn.
lore.uncommon: Is so small and shiny that it slides out of your hand like a wet noodle.
lore.rare: Wriggles up out of the ground whenever a storm rumbles, as if it heard its name.
lore.epic: Came up with a thousand others after a thunderstorm and the lawn looked like spaghetti.
lore.legendary: Has predicted every thunderstorm for twenty years by popping out of the ground first.

lore.common: Hangs from a branch so still that people try to tie their washing to it.
lore.uncommon: Has a long pointy nose and keyhole-shaped eyes that let it see straight down its own snout.
lore.rare: Stretches across the gap between two trees like a green rope bridge, and the lizards walk straight into it.
lore.epic: Draped itself over every vine in the jungle and the monkeys didn't know which ones were safe to swing on.
lore.legendary: Pretended to be a vine so well that a botanist gave it a Latin name for plants.

lore.common: Swims across the lake right next to the paddling children, then pretends it was there first.
lore.uncommon: Snatches fish from under the fisherman's float and takes them home for dinner.
lore.rare: Lies flat on a lily pad in the sun, and the frogs keep sitting on it by mistake.
lore.epic: Swam the whole length of the lake in front of the regatta, and every rower stopped to watch.
lore.legendary: Caught so many fish in the river that the herons started following it around for tips.

lore.common: Builds a new web across the barn door every night, so the farmer walks into it every morning.
lore.uncommon: Eats its old web each evening, then spins a fresh one like it's making the bed.
lore.rare: Spun a web so big in the hayloft that it caught a sparrow, then politely let it go.
lore.epic: Covered every beam in the barn with webs so thick that the cows thought it had snowed indoors.
lore.legendary: Wrote a word in its web above the pigsty, and the whole county came to read it.

lore.common: Spins a web right across the garden path at exactly face height.
lore.uncommon: Has bold black and yellow stripes, as if it is going to a football match.
lore.rare: Stitches a thick zigzag down the middle of its web, which nobody understands.
lore.epic: Spun webs across every gap in the hedge, and the garden looked like it was wrapped for a party.
lore.legendary: Spun a web so huge between two trees that a balloon got stuck in it, and it kept the balloon.

lore.common: Walks across the bathroom wall on legs so long that it looks like it's on stilts.
lore.uncommon: Bobs its whole body up and down when frightened, as if it's dancing.
lore.rare: Lets go of one leg when grabbed by a bird, and just walks away on the rest.
lore.epic: Huddled with a thousand friends in one corner of the shed, so the whole wall looked furry.
lore.legendary: Walked across an entire garden pond on its long legs without ever getting its body wet.

lore.common: Hides in your shoe overnight and waits for you to put your foot in it.
lore.uncommon: Carries all its babies on its back, so it looks like it's wearing a lumpy jacket.
lore.rare: Glows bright blue under a torch at night, like a little neon sign.
lore.epic: Marched out of the sand with a hundred cousins and the whole desert camp moved to a hotel.
lore.legendary: Survived being frozen in a block of ice, thawed out, and went straight back to work.

lore.common: Sits in the bath every morning and refuses to leave until someone fetches a glass.
lore.uncommon: Drops from the ceiling on a silk thread right in front of your face.
lore.rare: Spun a web across the front door overnight and caught the postman.
lore.epic: Covered the whole attic in webs so thick that the old furniture looked like it was wearing lace.
lore.legendary: Spun a single silk thread from the church tower to the bakery, and the whole town tried to walk along it.

lore.common: Runs across the kitchen floor so fast that the cat isn't sure what it saw.
lore.uncommon: Has eyes that shine green when you point a torch at the lawn at night.
lore.rare: Carries its babies on its back and won't put them down, even to eat.
lore.epic: Hunted every beetle on the lawn in one night, and the gardener found a perfectly tidy grass.
lore.legendary: Raised a thousand spiderlings on its back at once and still won the sprint across the patio.

lore.common: Mistakes floating plastic bags for jellyfish and gets very grumpy when they taste of nothing.
lore.uncommon: Has a soft leathery shell instead of a hard one, and is quite smug about how light it is.
lore.rare: Dived deeper than a submarine to find jellyfish, then came up and asked what all the fuss was about.
lore.epic: Ate every jellyfish off the beach in one week, and the swimmers had their best summer ever.
lore.legendary: Swam across the entire ocean and back to lay its eggs on the same beach where it hatched.

lore.common: Buries itself in the mud at the bottom of the pond and gets cross when anyone stirs it.
lore.uncommon: Has a hinged shell that closes like a box, so it can shut the door on you.
lore.rare: Pokes just its nose above the muddy water to breathe, so the ducks keep paddling into a nostril.
lore.epic: Spent the whole drought buried in the mud, and walked out when the rain came back as if nothing had happened.
lore.legendary: Slept in the same patch of mud for so many years that the frogs think it's a rock and hold meetings on it.

names.legendary: Old Thomasina, a Hundred and Fifty Years

lore.common: Pulls its head inside its shell whenever it hears its own name.
lore.uncommon: Crosses the lawn so slowly that the grass grows taller while it walks.
lore.rare: Paddled across the pond with a duckling riding on its shell, and pretended it hadn't noticed.
lore.epic: Spun on its shell on the ice so fast that the whole pond had to stop skating to watch.
lore.legendary: Has lived for a hundred and fifty years and still hasn't finished crossing the garden.

names.legendary: Captain Chompers, King of the Bathtub

lore.common: Floats on its back in the bath and stares at your toes.
lore.uncommon: Squeaks every time someone steps on it in the dark.
lore.rare: Snapped its plastic jaws on the dog's tail, and the dog has been suspicious of baths ever since.
lore.epic: Led every toy in the toybox in a midnight raid on the biscuit tin.
lore.legendary: Survived a hundred baths, three dogs and a washing machine, and still has every one of its plastic teeth.

lore.common: Grows right in the middle of the lawn exactly where you wanted to sit down.
lore.uncommon: Is built from tiny bits of pebble and pine needles, carried one at a time.
lore.rare: Sent out scouts that found the picnic basket before the family had unpacked.
lore.epic: Grew into such a big ant city that the gardener had to mow around it.
lore.legendary: Built a mound so tall that the woodpeckers use it as a lookout tower.

lore.common: Sits on the rosebuds sucking out the sap and leaves sticky drips on the car below.
lore.uncommon: Is milked by ants for its sweet juice, and pretends it doesn't mind.
lore.rare: Had babies that were already pregnant, so the rosebush filled up in a week.
lore.epic: Covered every rosebush in the park so thickly that the roses looked like they'd grown green fur.
lore.legendary: Became the mother of a million aphids in one summer, and the ladybirds had a party.

lore.common: Smiles at everyone through the tank glass, even when it's being told off.
lore.uncommon: Has feathery frills round its head that wave like a fancy collar.
lore.rare: Grew back a whole new leg after the fish nibbled it, and looked very pleased with itself.
lore.epic: Grinned at the aquarium visitors so happily that the whole queue grinned back for an hour.
lore.legendary: Never bothered to grow up into a salamander, and has been a cheerful baby for a hundred years.

names.legendary: Pogona, Bearded Ruler of the Lamp

lore.common: Lies under the heat lamp all day and refuses to move for its dinner.
lore.uncommon: Waves one arm slowly at other lizards, like it's saying hello from a distance.
lore.rare: Puffs out its spiky beard and turns it black whenever it's grumpy.
lore.epic: Turned its beard so black and puffed it so big that the cat backed out of the room.
lore.legendary: Has bossed the same heat lamp for fifteen years, and the family has bought it a second lamp to share.

names.legendary: Hivemother, Keeper of a Million Cells

lore.common: Hums so loudly in the garden that the neighbours think the fridge is broken.
lore.uncommon: Is built from wax cells in perfect hexagons, and is very fussy about straight lines.
lore.rare: Fills every cell with honey and won't let anyone have a spoonful without a fight.
lore.epic: Sent out a swarm so huge that it hung from the lamp post like a buzzing fruit.
lore.legendary: Made so much honey in one year that the whole village had toast for breakfast for a decade.

lore.common: Curls up into a C shape when you dig it up, and pretends you didn't see it.
lore.uncommon: Chews on the roots of the lawn, which is why that patch of grass is brown.
lore.rare: Has been living inside the same rotting log for three years, eating its way through.
lore.epic: Ate through every root under the lawn in one summer, and the grass came up like a carpet.
lore.legendary: Spent five years underground growing, then came out as the biggest beetle in the forest.

lore.common: Rolls one eye at you while the other keeps watching the television.
lore.uncommon: Holds on to branches with feet shaped like tiny pliers, so it's very hard to put down.
lore.rare: Changed colour to match the curtains, and the family searched the house for an hour.
lore.epic: Changed colours so fast while arguing with a rival that the tree looked like a fireworks show.
lore.legendary: Flicked its tongue twice the length of its body and caught a fly from across the room.

lore.common: Hangs from the leaf so still that people think it's a leaf, then wiggles when they touch it.
lore.uncommon: Is held up by a tiny silk button and refuses to explain how it got there.
lore.rare: Shimmers with tiny gold dots in the morning light, as if it's been sprinkled with glitter for a special occasion.
lore.epic: Burst open with a hundred others on the same morning and the garden filled with butterflies.
lore.legendary: Spent the whole winter hanging under the garden shed, then opened up as the first butterfly of spring.

lore.common: Buzzes so loudly in the tree outside your window that you can't hear the television.
lore.uncommon: Leaves its empty skin stuck to the fence, perfectly in one piece.
lore.rare: Clicks its belly to sing, so loudly that the dogs lie down and cover their ears.
lore.epic: Came up with a billion others after seventeen years, and the whole forest buzzed for a month.
lore.legendary: Waited underground for seventeen years for the perfect summer, then sang all the way through it.

lore.common: Hangs in the corner of the shed wrapped in silk and won't come out, no matter how nicely you ask.
lore.uncommon: Wrapped itself so snugly in silk that it looks like a tiny sleeping bag.
lore.rare: Spun one thread of silk so long that it would reach the end of the street and back.
lore.epic: Hung in a cluster of a hundred cocoons from the porch, and the visitors thought it was a strange new lamp.
lore.legendary: Spun a silk thread a whole mile long without a single knot, then went to sleep inside it.

lore.common: Lies at the bottom of the toybox and bites your fingers every time you reach for something else.
lore.uncommon: Has a huge painted grin that looks friendly until the lights go out.
lore.rare: Snapped its plastic jaws so hard that it jumped off the shelf and landed in the goldfish bowl.
lore.epic: Hid under every bed in the nursery in turn, and the children slept with their feet tucked in for a week.
lore.legendary: Was the favourite toy of three generations of children, and still has all its plastic teeth.

names.legendary: Saurus Rex, Last of the Giants

lore.common: Leaves enormous footprints in the garden mud and blames the neighbours' dog.
lore.uncommon: Has a long tail that knocks over anything left on a low table.
lore.rare: Stood so still in the museum hall that the visitors thought it was a skeleton, then sneezed.
lore.epic: Stomped across the valley so heavily that every pond had little ripples for a week.
lore.legendary: Survived the end of the dinosaurs by hiding in a very deep cave, and came out only to complain about the noise.

lore.common: Stands in the middle of the carpet so that someone steps on it every single night.
lore.uncommon: Roars when you press its tummy, usually at three in the morning.
lore.rare: Lost its tail under the sofa years ago and has been looking for it ever since.
lore.epic: Led every plastic dinosaur in the playroom in a stampede across the rug, and knocked down the block tower.
lore.legendary: Survived the washing machine, the dog and the garden pond, and is still the favourite toy in the house.

lore.common: Hides inside the folded towel, then runs out across your hand when you dry your face.
lore.uncommon: Waves the pincers on its back end at anyone who disturbs it, which looks silly but works.
lore.rare: Chewed holes in every dahlia petal in the garden so the flowers looked like lace.
lore.epic: Moved into every flower pot on the patio at once, and the gardener now waters them very carefully.
lore.legendary: Guarded its eggs all winter under a stone, licked them clean every day, and raised fifty earwig babies.

lore.common: Flies into your bedroom and blinks on the ceiling all night like a broken nightlight.
lore.uncommon: Lights up its tail to say hello to other fireflies, and gets very confused by torches.
lore.rare: Flashed its light in perfect time with all its neighbours, so the whole tree blinked at once.
lore.epic: Lit up the meadow with a thousand friends so brightly that the campers turned off their lanterns.
lore.legendary: Blinked so brightly in the forest that the lost hikers followed it all the way home.

lore.common: Jumps off the dog onto your ankle just as you sit down on the sofa.
lore.uncommon: Hitches a ride on the cat for a holiday, and never asks where it's going.
lore.rare: Jumped a hundred times its own height and landed on the ceiling light.
lore.epic: Moved into the carpet with ten thousand friends and the whole family started scratching at the same time.
lore.legendary: Jumped from the dog to the moon, it says, but it was actually just a lightbulb.

lore.common: Buzzes round your head while you're trying to read, then lands on the exact page.
lore.uncommon: Bangs into the closed window over and over, even with the door open beside it.
lore.rare: Dodged every swat with a rolled-up newspaper and landed on the newspaper.
lore.epic: Brought a swarm of friends to the barbecue and nobody got a burger without company.
lore.legendary: Escaped a hundred swats, three fly swatters and one very angry chef, and lived to tell every fly in town.

lore.common: Walks across the ceiling right above your bed and chirps when you're trying to sleep.
lore.uncommon: Licks its own eyeballs clean, because it doesn't have any eyelids.
lore.rare: Walked straight up the window glass without slipping, then stared in at dinner.
lore.epic: Patrolled every wall of the house in one night, and not a single moth was left in the hall.
lore.legendary: Climbed the tallest glass tower in the city on its sticky toes, then caught a moth at the very top.

lore.common: Hovers in a little cloud right where you want to walk, then follows you home.
lore.uncommon: Flies straight into your eye on a sunny day, every single time.
lore.rare: Is so small that it flies through window netting and laughs at it.
lore.epic: Formed a cloud so thick over the lake that the swans had to fly around it.
lore.legendary: Is so tiny that nobody can catch it, and it has bothered every picnic in history.

lore.common: Drips honey on every surface it touches, then sticks to the tablecloth.
lore.uncommon: Every single cell is a perfect hexagon, and it won't stop showing off about it.
lore.rare: Shines like gold in the sunlight, so the bears keep trying to break into the shed.
lore.epic: Overflowed with so much honey that it flooded the hive, and the bees had to swim out.
lore.legendary: Held enough honey to sweeten every cup of tea in the village for a whole winter.

lore.common: Flies into the kitchen, circles the fruit bowl three times and leaves you hiding behind the door.
lore.uncommon: Chews wood into paper to build its nest, so it's basically a flying paper factory.
lore.rare: Raided the picnic and carried off a whole slice of ham, all by itself.
lore.epic: Sent its whole squadron to patrol the orchard, and the apple pickers stayed indoors all week.
lore.legendary: Built a paper nest the size of a wheelbarrow under the barn roof, and nobody has dared to move it.

lore.common: Circles the lampshade in the middle of the room for hours, as if it's lost the way out.
lore.uncommon: Rubs its front legs together like it's planning something.
lore.rare: Tastes your food with its feet, so it walks across your sandwich to check.
lore.epic: Brought a whole crowd of flies into the kitchen at once, and dinner was eaten very quickly.
lore.legendary: Has outlived every flyswatter in the house and still lands on the cake every birthday.

lore.common: Moves into your hair and makes you scratch in the middle of the school photo.
lore.uncommon: Glues its tiny eggs to hair so tightly that the comb has to work very hard.
lore.rare: Hopped from one head to another during story time and nobody saw a thing.
lore.epic: Spread through the whole school in a week and every parent got the same letter.
lore.legendary: Has lived in human hair since the very first people, and has never once been invited.

lore.common: Flicks its forked tongue at everything, including the dustbin, to see if it's edible.
lore.uncommon: Swims across the river with its tail swishing like a crocodile, then climbs a tree to dry off.
lore.rare: Raided the chicken run and carried off the eggs without breaking a single one.
lore.epic: Swam up the river with a dozen cousins, and the fishermen moved to a different spot.
lore.legendary: Grew so long that it can stand on its back legs and look over the garden fence.

lore.common: Whines in your ear just as you're falling asleep, then hides when you turn on the light.
lore.uncommon: Bites your ankle under the table and leaves an itchy bump the size of a pea.
lore.rare: Found the only gap in the mosquito net and invited all its friends in.
lore.epic: Raided the campsite with a million cousins, and every camper went home with spots.
lore.legendary: Has bitten every explorer, king and famous scientist in history, and still won't say sorry.

lore.common: Wanders out of the pond and gets stuck in the garden watering can.
lore.uncommon: Has skin so smooth and slippery that it slides straight out of your fingers.
lore.rare: Waves its tail at other newts in spring to show off its wavy crest.
lore.epic: Moved into every puddle in the park after a storm, and the ducks had to share.
lore.legendary: Lived in the same garden pond for thirty years, and has seen five families of goldfish come and go.

lore.common: Sits on your windowsill with its arms folded, judging everything you do.
lore.uncommon: Swivels its head right round to stare at you, like a tiny green owl.
lore.rare: Snatched a fly from the air so fast that the fly is still wondering where it went.
lore.epic: Stood perfectly still in the rose bush for a whole day, and the garden ran out of flies.
lore.legendary: Caught a hummingbird by mistake, let it go politely, and has never lived it down.

lore.common: Hides in the damp cellar and appears in the washing basket at the worst possible time.
lore.uncommon: Its skin must stay damp, so it gets very grumpy on sunny days.
lore.rare: Grew back its own tail after a bird pulled it off, and the bird was very confused.
lore.epic: Crawled up every damp wall in the old castle after the rain and the tourists thought the walls were moving.
lore.legendary: Walked out of a burning log on the campfire and gave every camper the fright of their life.

lore.common: Dashes across the bathroom floor as soon as you turn on the light.
lore.uncommon: Eats the glue in old books, so the pages fall out when you try to read.
lore.rare: Can live for a whole year without food, and still looks shiny.
lore.epic: Moved into the library basement and ate the glue out of every book on the bottom shelf.
lore.legendary: Has been living in the same old house for three hundred years, and has eaten half of every book in it.

lore.common: Hangs in the corner of the window and makes everyone too nervous to open it.
lore.uncommon: Is wrapped in so much silk that it looks like a little cotton ball.
lore.rare: Wiggles when you touch it, as if something inside wants to say hello.
lore.epic: Burst open with a hundred tiny spiders at once, and they all went in different directions.
lore.legendary: Hatched a thousand spiderlings that floated away on silk threads to every garden in the town.

lore.common: Pretends to be a stick so well that someone tried to use it to roast a marshmallow.
lore.uncommon: Sways back and forth as it walks, like a twig blowing in the wind.
lore.rare: Ate every leaf in the tank in one night, then pretended to be a stick so nobody would notice.
lore.epic: Hid in the hedge so well that the gardener trimmed a hundred sticks and missed every one.
lore.legendary: Grew as long as a ruler and still managed to hide on a twig half its size.

names.legendary: Tyranno, King of the Old World

lore.common: Can't reach its own snacks because its arms are too short, so it shouts until someone helps.
lore.uncommon: Has teeth as big as bananas, and is very proud of every single one.
lore.rare: Roared so loudly at a herd of plant-eaters that they dropped their lunches and ran.
lore.epic: Stomped so hard across the valley that every tree dropped its leaves at once.
lore.legendary: Was the biggest meat-eater the world had ever seen, and still couldn't scratch its own nose.

lore.common: Chews through the skirting board so quietly that nobody notices until the shelf falls off.
lore.uncommon: Builds tunnels of mud everywhere it goes, like a tiny road crew.
lore.rare: Ate the inside of a wooden chair and left the outside looking perfectly fine.
lore.epic: Built a tower of mud taller than a giraffe, with its own air conditioning.
lore.legendary: Ate an entire wooden barn from the inside out, and the farmer only found out when he leaned on it.

lore.common: Waits on a blade of grass with its arms out, ready to grab anyone who walks past.
lore.uncommon: Climbs up your leg so slowly that you don't notice until it's settled in.
lore.rare: Swelled up to the size of a pea after one meal, then dropped off for a nap.
lore.epic: Waited in the long grass with a thousand friends, and the hikers checked their socks for a week.
lore.legendary: Waited a whole year without eating for the right dog to pass, then rode it to the beach.

lore.common: Bumps into the doorframe with its horns every single time it comes indoors.
lore.uncommon: Has a big bony frill behind its head like a giant dinner plate.
lore.rare: Pushed over a tree with its horns just to get to the ferns at the top.
lore.epic: Charged across the plains with the whole herd, and every meat-eater moved to the hills.
lore.legendary: Faced down the biggest meat-eater in the valley with its three horns, and walked off chewing a fern.

lore.common: Hangs under the garden shed roof so that nobody dares fetch the lawnmower.
lore.uncommon: Is made of chewed-up paper so neatly that it looks like a grey lantern.
lore.rare: Hums so loudly in the eaves that the house sounds like it's purring.
lore.epic: Sent out its whole family to the summer fête, and the cake stall closed early.
lore.legendary: Grew as big as a beach ball in one summer under the porch, and the family moved their door.

lore.common: Lives under the doormat and scuttles away whenever someone comes to the door.
lore.uncommon: Sheds its old shell in two halves, so for a day it walks around half old and half new.
lore.rare: Breathes through tiny gills, so it gets very cross when the garden dries out.
lore.epic: Turned the whole compost heap into rich soil in one summer, with ten thousand friends helping.
lore.legendary: Has been recycling the forest floor for millions of years, and still hasn't been thanked once.
